qualification: Software regression tests and board build; stopped-motor hardware check pending; no spinning-motor or flight qualification.
backport_adaptations: Append inverted-DShot and capture-DMA enum modes after existing Other9; no upstream RPM enum introduced.
TIM1 is timer index0; four motor outputs share this timer. TIM2/TIM3 remain PWM servo outputs.
Reject invalid GCR symbols before nibble shifting; reject oversized/zero run lengths and handle16bit capture wrap.
Invalid captures do not refresh per-ESC samples or masquerade as measured zero RPM.
100ms valid-reply freshness for online flags, snapshot ISR-written RPM/time under a critical section.
Esc armed flags reflect actual arming; no unconditional armed flags while disarmed.
Disable unused rover position controller to fit flash.
timing_note: esc_report timestamp is the FC time of successfully decoded capture processing. It is not an ESC-clock rotor measurement time. Requalify pose/command timing and firmware identity before flight-launcher use; never merely relabel old timing qualification.
rollback: Use original main5_set3_gcc9 ba91960 image and fresh before-flash parameter backup. Revert BDShot/serial configuration to its captured previous settings.
production_changes: Retain tested early input release for initialized motor GPIOs at TX completion.
Keep GPIO initialization, selected capture register, DMA mapping and processed channel aligned.
Normal throttle/special-command encoder restored; normal PX4 disarmed STOP handling retained.
Bound round-robin selection and reject invalid channel indices/missing mappings.
Publish FC decode-processing timestamps for valid RPM replies; preserve old timestamp on invalid replies.
Armed telemetry flags follow actual arming, not enabled output peripherals.
removed_diagnostics: Fixed channel and alternate release modes
Read-only ESC bootloader/configuration utility and its TIM13 requirement
MORPH_ESC_DIAG output-startup interlock; rcS matches flight baseline
preserved_flight_baseline: Controller, EKF2 and allocator source unchanged.
Arm publisher and loaded-neutral calibration unchanged.
SD benchmark/stress tools restored; unused rover position controller disabled for flash space.
remaining_validation: Disarmed boot and stationary telemetry using this exact flight binary.
Correct nonzero RPM, motor mapping/pole conversion and longest inter-reply gaps during rotating operation.
Achieved esc_status ULog sample rate and command/mocap/RPM time alignment.
No-load/load/flight behavior and timing qualification remain untested under the user instruction never to arm or send thrust.
commissioning: This is a flight-capable candidate, not a claim of flight qualification. Normal actuator commands are enabled by the software; do not use old bench-only assumptions.
